verdict.rationale: Runloop's core offering is Devboxes—isolated sandboxed Linux environments explicitly designed for running AI agent code without touching user infrastructure, backed by snapshotting, blueprints, secure tunnels, and even AI gateways that hide API keys from executed code. Docs also emphasize scale (10k+ parallel sandboxes) and fast startup, aligning directly with safe untrusted-code execution. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on security validation or third-party audit confirming isolation guarantees beyond vendor docs.
